scope: Rust preparation against the pinned Go exporter: every accepted fixture, every request kept under validation/, randomized variants of all 42 production requests and of ten builds across every class, each prepared both ways and compared as whole prepared states with no tolerance.

criteria.comparison: whole prepared v2 state, every value and list

cases.notes: The folder also holds 165 record files that are not requests, which the comparison reads as invalid requests and this record leaves out. At 8f8ac98b9, 2563 matched and 8 were refused: a rotation's activate aura action, Weaponmaster's armor ignore with a mace or staff in four Arms presets and Tenets of the Silver Hand in three Paladin variants. ee3235c56 prepares those, and all 8 match, the Tenets ones also against Undead targets.

cases.generator: python3 tools/sweep.py <production request> --seed 77 --count 10 for each of the 42 production-*.request.json fixtures

python3 tools/sweep.py with seeds 11 (Frost reference, races drawn), 23 and 41 (Balance and Feral bear Druid, three Warlocks, Protection Warrior, Paladin auto attacks, Marksmanship Hunter, Fire and Arcane Mage)
cases.notes: The 19 refusals are Night Elf and Dwarf Mages, which have no base stats in the reference's tables (code race). Seed 23 first found one mismatch: Rust registered a stack observer for a rotation condition of an action Go never builds; fixed in this branch before the counts above.

notes: Each request is prepared by `forever-engine prepare --request` and by the exporter's `prepare --infile`; a refusal exits with status 5 and its code. The counts are from runs at the commits named in each case's notes, on the branch that ends at the source revision.
